runs.scope: Same frozen24h forced physics and initial states with isolated phase-root dependency bindings. All physical code bodies reused. Paired order alternates by region; no timing speed gate or parameter fitting. State-equivalence checks must precede backend adoption.

frozen_plan.purpose: One fixed24h regional case repeated with two equivalent numerical phase backends
frozen_plan.initial: Same previous post-conversion atmospheric T/water and globally balanced open-mean source wind. Surface starts from archived simulated ground temperature reduced to sea level with fixed6K/km; initial transfer rain and actual liquidH returned before run, excluded from run rain.

omitted_upper.description: Fixed exterior isothermal emitting slab above380hPa. T from initial6K/km source profile at p_top/2 with200K floor; dry tau uses declared dry opacity times omitted pressure mass. DownwardLW=sigma*T^4*(1-exp(-tau_above)). This is an externally maintained partial-column boundary, NOT TOA.

frozen_plan.forcing: Daily-mean Earth-orbit solar at evolving source day, prescribed25% outside reflection and drySW attenuation through omitted upper air; greyLW depth=kappa_dry*Md+.025*W, updates with actual vapor. Neutral loglaw at explicit initial pressure-derived reference height; signed dew/evap; finite liquid/heat reservoir. No forced temperature restoration.
frozen_plan.paired_control: All physical parameters, initial fields, source winds, forcing and code bodies unchanged. Only the liquid root implementation differs. Selected dependencies bound into independent function namespaces; original module globals unchanged.
frozen_plan.approximation: Exploratory grey optical depths and neutral roughness are declared choices, not measured or Earth-fitted opacities. No clouds/spectral scattering, surface stability/gusts, ice/runoff/deep heating, terrain or nonlinear momentum. Daily-mean rather than diurnal forcing. Partial upper boundary and lateral fields held externally.
frozen_plan.energy_water: All actual vapor enthalpy/sensible exchange debited from finite surface; phase/dynamic rain returns mass and actual liquidH exactly once and changes surface heat capacity. Total gas+kinetic+surface E changes only by declared radiation/top/lateral power; total atmospheric+surfacewater changes only by lateral vapor transport.
frozen_plan.failure: Reject exhausted surface/airwater or out-of-domain temperatures; preserve all failures/partials; no parameter changes, clipped sources, replacement cases or adaptive post-outcome tuning.
